ChangeNotes.Value:
v2.0.0 - the biggest release since the mod was born.
MARRIAGE BY COURTSHIP - win a heart, walk its road, wed for real. - Characters can now truly be courted in conversation. Their heart walks its own road (liking, love, readiness, betrothal, wedding), moved by their own judgment of your talks, one honest step a day. Nothing is sealed by words alone: the betrothal and the wedding each take your confirming click, and the wedding is the real game marriage - cutscene, clan, children and all. - They write their OWN misgivings: when marriage enters your talks they set down what honestly worries them about a life together, in their own words (up to five, or none if their heart is clear). Talk them over openly; only they decide when life has answered one. Their readiness waits until nothing they wrote still stands. You see the count under their name, and a button opens the full list with their settling notes. - Station guards the hand, not the heart: a great house's daughter may love anyone, but her hand asks a suitor of standing (softened once her heart is fully won). Noble kin must bless the match - the head of her house asks a bride-price, haggled in real talk or by letter, sealed by your click; once betrothed he appears in your letter window even if you never met him. - Companion brides and grooms are first-class (vanilla forbids them): wed the wanderer riding at your side and she is raised to lordship the game's own way, keeping her place and duties in your party. - Plays well with Marry Anyone. New mod options under 'Life of the NPCs'.
THE BATTLE CHRONICLE - your battles become their memories. - Every battle you fight is set down: where, when, attack or defense, field/siege/hideout/sea (War Sails included), both armies by size and kind, the fallen and wounded, prisoners, captives freed, the spoils, plunder, renown and influence. Battles earn names by their deeds ('The Grand Victory near Ortysia, over Thrice Our Number'). - Everyone who fought at your side remembers it in the first person - what their own hand did, whether they came out unhurt, wounded or captive. The freshest battle is fresh in their mind; older ones they can call back whole ('what happened at the storming of Varcheg?'). - Characters know their own body too: how far their wounds have mended, when they are in no state to fight - and they see yours. - Clean with the Training Battles mod: drills are never mistaken for real war.
THE ROAD JOURNAL - your companions witness your everyday life. - Those riding with you see the last stops of the road: where you called and how long, what you traded and for how much, the men you hired or left in a garrison, the captives sold. And the tasks you carry, with their deadlines - and how each one ended, succeeded or failed.
HIRING BY HANDSHAKE - Agree service and price with an unhired wanderer in the talk itself. A popup names the exact price and only your click hires. Haggling is railed within honest bounds; the daily wage is never negotiable. Sellswords quote their true price and open at their worth instead of inventing figures - and they know their own gear now.
THE DIRECTOR'S SPARK - every soul begins as somebody. - The first time you meet a character, one small AI call writes them a private starting truth (an old wound, an odd habit, a vanity) grown from their real story, traits and your world prompt. It lands in their editable prompt file - read it, rewrite it, erase it. New option 'Starting personality': Generate / Ask first / Off.
THE NARRATOR IS GONE - everything is first person now. - No more unseen voice narrating a character's life. Arrivals, letters, the urge to seek you out, a hiring struck, even the settling of old memories now pass through their own mind in their own voice. Old saves keep their recorded moments exactly as they were.
ONE DEEPER MEMORY INSTEAD OF THREE LISTS - The separate rosters of 'lasting truths' and 'personal goals' are retired - they restated what memory already held and made souls repeat themselves. Everything lives in the one memory they rewrite, now invited to be far richer. NPCs also hold 40 exchanges word for word (was 30) and keep 20 after condensing (was 15). Nothing you already have is deleted. - You can SEE how full a memory is: a live gauge under their name (share of the AI's memory, tokens, exchanges, age of the oldest). Every memory dial is now in the mod options under 'Memory', live, no restart.
THE WINDOWS - Edit prompts without leaving the game: 'Their prompt' and 'World prompt' open an editor inside the chat and letter windows - Save, and the change speaks from the very next reply. - Tidier headers (the grey lines stack instead of printing over each other), the deep memory opens as its own page, every page has a '← Back' button, and the talk menu is tidied ('Speak freely with me.' at the top, 'Farewell.' at the bottom).
FIXES - Battle tallies told the truth about who struck down whom (a heavy non-killing blow was counted as a kill). - Scouts no longer mistrust the peaceable: a band at peace with you is named plainly as no threat, and a strong neutral warband is pointed out as shelter. - The player is no longer mis-gendered in gendered languages.
Full model guide: github.com/TraxData313/ImmersiveAI/blob/master/docs/choosing-a-model.md
